description: Local copy of the v1/v2 canonical city list. Kept here so the azure/ folder is self-contained; the source of truth is ../shared/cities.json. v2 reads this list at runtime from the `config` container in ADLS Gen2 — no code changes needed to add or remove cities.
deploy_step: Step 3 of azure/deploy.md uploads this file to abfss://config@<storage>.dfs.core.windows.net/cities.json
